head: 143642b
concerns: Gate clauses L7 (fresh_verifier) and L8 (fresh_guardian_g6) are marked PENDING/false in the gate JSON — this is by design: they are the fresh-verification clauses that THIS verdict and the fresh Verifier's verdict satisfy. The substantive 8/10 PASS reflects L1-L6, L9, L10.

gc_apply does not itself enforce the §23 grace period — the contract explicitly delegates grace-period enforcement to the caller. A caller that skips the grace period could delete facts referenced by an in-flight query. This is an accepted architecture decision, not a defect, but production callers must honor it.

add_facts_batch increments `count` once per batch rather than once per fact — cosmetic accounting quirk (returns count=1 per call regardless of fact count); does not affect lifecycle correctness or fact storage.

register_world uses world_id=1 (hardcoded) in m6_production_indexing.py for the single-build default path. Multi-variant/multi-image builds would need distinct world_ids per build to keep refcounts independent — current production indexing path does not yet differentiate worlds by variant/image, only by build_name string.
summary: M7.4 lifecycle authority migration is GENUINE and safe for production at HEAD 143642b. BuildSetStore in m6_store.py exposes the full World lifecycle: register_world (L267) populates the m6_world_builds World→Builds map, add_fact (L146) interns facts with BuildSet retention, and stats (L587) reports store health. GC is reachability-based, not age-only: gc_unreachable_facts (L340) computes a fact reachable iff fact.BuildSet ∩ {builds with refcount>0} ≠ ∅, and §2.7 explicitly forbids age-only GC. SQLite persistence (index-m6.db, WAL mode, busy_timeout=30s) preserves the store across restarts. m6_production_indexing.py calls store.register_world(1, {build_name}) at L83, populating the World→Builds map before fact extraction. runner.py integrates M6 as the production WRITE authority (L1107-1141): after the legacy index completes, index_legacy_db_into_m6 runs, and failure raises IndexIntegrityError (authoritative). v2 finalization is gated behind M6 authority: _v2_finalize_enabled = _v2_authority AND NOT _m6_write_authority (L948-952), so when M6 write authority is ON (default FW_CONTEXT_M6_WRITE_AUTHORITY=1), v2 finalize is DISABLED — M6 owns the World/GC/restart lifecycle. The gate reports 8/10 PASS; the 2 PENDING clauses (L7 fresh_verifier, L8 fresh_guardian_g6) are the fresh-verification clauses this verdict satisfies. M7.1+M7.2+M7.3 regression intact (L10 PASS) and M5/M3B/M4 regression intact (L9 PASS).
